answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 9 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The sparrow multiplier is published, charged in comet, and anchor lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 712 identities would post 1491 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
